messages:
Maria (oncall): handing off to night shift — quick summary below, please ping if anything looks off. I'm primary until 23:00 PT (03:00 UTC), Jordan you're secondary.

incident-bot: INC-2028 opened -> High: embeddings-queue-p99 latency spike, Redis cache eviction rate increased (service: model-cache). Pager sent to oncall@redwood.

Maria (oncall): current impact: ~1.8% of active requests are suffering degraded quality due to cache-misses; some traffic is falling back to the quantized-small model which increases downstream latency slightly. Two paying customers saw elevated error rates (cust-alpha, cust-gamma) — CS alerted.

Samir: any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-13_21:45 to embeddings-service (sha: a1f3d2) succeeded. No model bundle changes.

Maria (oncall): no infra deploys since then. We suspect a change in request pattern (larger prefixes) + cache pressure. Observed TTL expiration spikes aligned with a burst at 21:37 PT.

Olivia: current mitigations in progress:
- scaled embeddings-worker deployment from 4 -> 6 replicas (kubectl applied)
- adjusted model-cache eviction threshold on region-us to 18GB -> 21GB (hotfix config toggle, safe rollback available)
- temporary rate-limiting rule added for heavy keys from cust-alpha (rule id rl-378), 60r/min for top-10 keys

Maria (oncall): also enabled fallback policy to route large requests to quantized-small for customers on trial only (not prod tier) to reduce pressure. That policy is reversible with rollback flag: fallback.disable=false.

Jordan (night): can you paste the exact commands you ran to scale and check pods?

Maria (oncall): sure — commands I used:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy embeddings-worker --replicas=6
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings-worker -o wide
kubectl -n infra set env config/model-cache EVICT_THRESHOLD=21GB --overwrite
```
and to tail logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-cache -c cache --since=15m | grep -E "evict|miss|error"`

Samir: how's Redis persistence? any RDB/AOF churn?

Maria (oncall): Redis AOF is fine; persistence latencies are normal. Evictions are memory-pressure based, not persistence. We're seeing a lot of cold-gets (cache-miss ratio up from 2% -> 9%).

Olivia: metrics to watch: grafana -> Inference / Embeddings / Queue latency p50/p95/p99, model-cache / evictions/sec, redis / used_memory_ratio, requests / fallback_rate. Bookmark: https://grafana.redwood/team/infra/d/embeddings?page=queue-overview

Jordan (night): for next steps please:
1) Monitor p99 latency and evictions for the next 60m. If p99 > 2.2s or evictions/sec > 120, escalate page to infra-sre.
2) If fallback_rate > 5% persistently for 10m, toggle fallback.disable=true to stop trial routing and notify CS.
3) If embeddings-worker CPU > 80% across replicas, consider scaling to 8 replicas, but watch memory on nodes.

Maria (oncall): adding playbook links — runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-queue.md, cache runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/model-cache-evictions.md. Use playbook step 'emergency-throttle' before scaling further.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2028 updated: severity -> elevated, linked ticket: TKT-8421. Current status: mitigations applied; monitoring.

Jordan (night): noted. I'll own until morning; I'll send hourly updates. First check in 15m. Do we have any scheduled jobs that could run overnight and cause spikes?

Maria (oncall): none scheduled in the next 6h in prod. I double-checked cron-jobs and ingestion pipelines. Batch indexing for cust-gamma finished at 21:05.

Samir: one additional tip — if you need a fast rollback for the cache config: `kubectl -n infra set env config/model-cache EVICT_THRESHOLD=18GB --overwrite` and redeploy config map reload which is hot: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/cache-config-reloader`.

Jordan (night): got it. I'm taking over now. Will report at +15m. Thanks Maria.

Maria (oncall): thanks, leaving docs and logs in the incident thread and the short TL;DR in the ticket. If you get paged for model-cache again, start with scaling + rate-limit before rolling back.

Jordan (night): accepted. ping me @Jordan for any noisy alerts. :thumbsup:

Maria (oncall): handing off — signing off. Good luck and ping if anything looks strange.

Jordan (night): first check: p99 has already dropped from 2.6s -> 1.9s after scaling, evictions/sec down to ~45. continuing to watch.

Olivia: noted, I'll update the customer-impact log and loop in CS.

incident-bot: INC-2028 note added by Jordan: "Scaled embeddings-worker -> 6, rate-limit rl-378 applied to cust-alpha, model-cache threshold increased. Monitoring stable."
